search_text: published ZDI-17-992 ZDI-CAN-4292 Quest NetVault Backup Server Process Manager Service NVBUBackup JobList Method SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-12-15 CVE-2017-17656 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-17656 7.5 ['Quest'] ['NetVault Backup'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of NVBUBackup JobList method requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the underlying database. title: Quest NetVault Backup Server Process Manager Service NVBUBackup JobList Method SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of NVBUBackup JobList method requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the underlying database.
